arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Kerr argued retroactivity and good faith point in opposite directions.
Mr. Dreeben argued the exclusionary rule must shape police conduct.
Chief Justice Roberts questioned the deterrence rationale for this specific case.
Justice Scalia stated the altered rule applies to the client's conduct.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of the exclusionary rule. It asks if evidence must be suppressed when police follow a binding circuit precedent that later proves wrong.
